description: Every branch of an `if=` / `else` chain mounts `<card>` through another declaration's render (`<pa>` / `<pb>` each render `<card/>`): E-DECL-RENDER-CYCLE-USE (#2139 r1 re-review MED-1).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-component-self-mount-error ("a use of a declaration inside its own render (directly or through other declarations' renders) that is unconditional on every path is a compile error at the use"); PA reading pa-ruled:S483-every-path-mounts
rationale: §66.6.2 rule 2 (S483 r2): a branch mounts what the renders of its uses mount on every path, too.
